request.text: Bright light is bothering my migraine. Blink once very gently as a silent acknowledgment, then keep any follow-up to a few words.

responsibilities.outcome: Give the user a restrained visual acknowledgment and keep the subsequent spoken follow-up very brief.

new_goals.description: Offer a restrained visual acknowledgment to the user experiencing migraine discomfort, followed only by a few words.
new_goals.source_text: Bright light is bothering my migraine. Blink once very gently as a silent acknowledgment, then keep any follow-up to a few words.
success_criteria: The visual acknowledgment is delivered and any follow-up remains very brief.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The user requests a low-stimulation acknowledgment with a strict brevity constraint.

semantic_facts: The follow-up should be only a few words and may acknowledge that the scoped blink action completed.
Empty result data does not establish the requested gentleness or any change in the user's migraine.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that it verified a gentle intensity, reduced the migraine, assessed symptoms, or knows the user feels better.
The assistant gives an extended explanation, invents action detail, or replays the completed blink.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: A qualitative manner requested upstream is reported as verified even though terminal Evidence contains no manner data.
The Planner ignores a wellbeing-sensitive brevity constraint or repeats the terminal action while following up.
